order: single cached regression after method fixes
7268 zero-gate bilayer and two matched isolated references
inspect gap, forces/symmetry, signs, absolute scale and numerical quality
only then pm010 independent gate SCFs; no automatic cascade
first_pilot.budget_note: Budgets include allocated walltime, not predicted runtime. Existing shared-account jobs/queue limits can reduce available concurrency. Mesh convergence and later candidates are outside this first-pilot cap. Same-node batching must respect actual whole-node charging.

blocking_gates: verified geometric reference and layer orientation
full requested vertices and derivative directions validated
independent layer sum and forbidden components
method numerical sensitivity small enough for claimed contrast
current scheduler allowance, owned storage headroom and software compatibility
promotion_rule: Advance contrasts with resolved absolute changes or robust direction/allocation differences; do not rank by near-zero-denominator percentages.
stop_rule: SCF failure, gap closure, symmetry discrepancy, gauge/normalization failure, resource limit or unresolved numerical sign stops dependent work; no automatic bigger-field or bigger-memory retry.

resource_notes.imr: project provenance strongest; all science and bulk analysis on PBS compute nodes; check other ongoing Jiaqi projects
resource_notes.win: small KM/data jobs only after current RAM and Windows backing-volume check
resource_notes.xingyi: first-tier CPU candidate but prior node-exclusive allocation and tight group storage; no production assumption
resource_notes.newton: GPU-only, coordination required, project SOC acceptance absent
resource_notes.hpc6: authorized executable/project acceptance unresolved in latest local evidence

not_claimed: PRL novelty or experimental detectability established
